title: com.cuvara.vfx inspect result
description: Result of the inspect verb (VfxCli.Run("inspect", {"effect": ...})) with ok true: the static facts of one effect that a lint reads. Node ids are the describe ids (contexts c<n>, blocks c<n>.b<m>, operators o<n>, parameters p<n>, systems s<n>). No timestamp: two calls on an unchanged effect give the same JSON.

effect.description: the effect as given: a prefab that holds one VisualEffect, or a .vfx asset

asset.description: the .vfx asset the facts are read from (the prefab's VisualEffect asset for a prefab)

visual_effect.description: hierarchy path of the GameObject with the VisualEffect, from the prefab root

recipe.description: the <Name>.vfxrecipe.json next to <Name>.vfx with the SHA-256 of its bytes, or null when there is none

build_target.description: the editor's active build target; texture formats are the ones imported for it

describe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the compact JSON describe returns for the asset (the build result's describe_sha256)

systems.description: one per VFX data, in describe order

name.description: the system name VFX Graph uses in shader names and the graph window: the author's title, or System, System (1), ...

capacity.description: null for a system without particles (a spawner)

outputs.description: every context of type Output, in describe order

type.description: the context class: VFXPlanarPrimitiveOutput, VFXComposedParticleOutput, VFXStaticMeshOutput, ...

blend_mode.description: the blendMode setting; null for an output without one (static mesh)

shader.description: the shader the output renders with: the one VFX Graph generated (a sub-asset of the .vfx, path and GUID of the .vfx), or for a static mesh output the shader it was given; null when none was found (a warning says why)

shader_graph.description: the Shader Graph of a Shader Graph output, else null

effective.description: render features after VFX Graph's own rules (sort Auto sorts Alpha and AlphaPremultiplied; soft particles need a transparent output; ...); null where the output type has no such feature

render_settings.description: the output's settings that the inspector or the graph shows in this configuration, by their VFX Graph names (sort, useSoftParticle, castShadows, cullMode, zWriteMode, zTestMode, useAlphaClipping, primitiveType, uvMode, ...), in declaration order; blendMode, shaderGraph, shader and materialSettings are reported elsewhere or are not values

textures.description: every texture the graph references (parameter values and input slots without a link) or a prefab override sets, once each, ordered by path then GUID

depth.description: slices of an array, depth of a 3D texture, cubemaps of a cubemap array, else 1

format.description: GraphicsFormat of the imported texture for build_target (R8G8B8A8_SRGB, RGBA_DXT5_SRGB, ...)

compression.description: TextureImporter compression (Uncompressed, Compressed, CompressedHQ, CompressedLQ); null without a TextureImporter

compressed_format.description: the imported GraphicsFormat is a block-compressed format

readable.description: a readable texture keeps a CPU copy next to the GPU one

estimated_bytes.description: GPU size of all mip levels from size, mip count and format; null for a render texture

used_by.description: describe slot addresses (c3.mainTexture), parameter ids (p0) and prefab:<override name>, sorted

exposed_properties.description: the exposed input parameters, in describe order

overrides.description: the prefab's overridden property-sheet entries of this property (a struct is stored as <name>_<field>)

hdr_colors.description: colour values with a channel above 1: Color and Gradient parameters, unlinked Color and Gradient slots, Vector3/Vector4 slots or parameters whose name contains color or colour, and prefab overrides of such properties; parameters first, then slots in describe order, then overrides

path.description: parameter id, slot address or prefab:<name>; a gradient key adds .color_keys.<index>

name.description: the exposed name of a parameter, else the slot name

rgba.description: alpha is null for a Vector3

peak.description: the largest of r, g, b

intensity.description: log2(peak), the Intensity of Unity's HDR colour picker, rounded to 4 decimals

hdr_peak.description: the largest peak of hdr_colors, null when there is none

value.description: a value as describe prints it: number, boolean, string (enums by name), list (vectors, colours), object (structs, gradients, curves, asset references) or null
